profile_text.body:
AlphaSense is a New York-based market intelligence and search platform founded in 2011. The company describes itself as providing AI-powered access to insights and market data across 500 million-plus documents. Its platform uses advanced AI models focused on high-quality content to generate outputs with sentence-level citations and no hallucinations, according to the site.

The company offers AlphaSense, categorized as Finance & Legal AI, which serves financial research and market intelligence functions. The platform features AI search, Smart Synonyms, Expert Insights, and Deep Research tools that use generative AI reasoning models to create comprehensive reports from complex data. According to the site, users like Recurve Capital and Royalty Pharma employ the platform for research efficiency and due diligence. The site notes AlphaSense received the highest possible score across 14 criteria including Vision, Innovation, Roadmap, and AI Agents, and states the company has dominated the market with its combination of premier content and domain-specific AI.

AlphaSense operates in a legal-exposure jurisdiction of New York, which reports 327 associated cases tracked by theworldofai.org. The platform's financial research applications may require controls for material nonpublic information management.
